scope: Failed in-memory construction proposal. No source shape or physical acceptance. Motion retains first/last samples here; full run was inspected locally. Reproduce by passing replica to evaluateAssembly with the current backend.

replica.title: Henry's medium ramp · 37-piece candidate

build.title: Henry's medium ramp
build.summary: Source-constrained reconstruction candidate. Read the independent evidence before building.

stages.title: Build the lower wedge
stages.instruction: Join two long isosceles sides and two square deck tiles. The medium flight has four pieces; it omits the small ramp's rear square.

materialQuestions: Source isosceles dimensions and magnets are uncalibrated; the simulated vehicle is an assumed proxy.

uncertainties.detail: Canopy roof pitch, triangular tessellation, end closures and red launch flap joins require additional fitting. Exact BOM alone does not validate this hypothesis.
Upper wedge elevation/support alignment and the blue turn's dihedral remain unresolved.

route.evidence: The 01:46 close-up shows Henry gesturing along the upper squares. No complete toy-car trajectory is visible. The roof route below is an inferred functional target, not a measured successful turn.

brief.prompt: Henry's medium ramp with a triangular passive turn
